# round 8 (6.10.2, 3 November 2026): stronger models for computers with far more memory than 64 GB. Her words (3 November 2026): "I also
# want Ingenium to be able to run stronger models and be strong enough to run on larger computers with far more RAM than 64GB. I don't

# the authors really have. Files over 50 GB come in parts (name-00001-of-0000N.gguf): every part is listed with its size and SHA-256.
